title: LandPulse AI Data Provenance Registry
description: Registry tracking dataset provenance, sources, data integrity, and verification standards.

registered_datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
registered_datasets.license: Public domain — Government of India transparency portal. Data visible to public without authentication.
registered_datasets.authenticity_notes: Data sourced from publicly visible HTML table and official published Gazette notifications on bhoomirashi.gov.in without authentication. Represents only what is visible on the public search interface. Raw files preserved unmodified.
registered_datasets.supervised_label_reason: The public search table does not contain project-level planned vs. actual completion dates, nor project delay status. A supervised delay prediction label CANNOT be constructed from this data alone.

transformation_history.description: Date strings converted to ISO 8601. NULL if unparseable.

registered_datasets.authenticity_notes: Data transcribed from MoRTH Annual Report 2022-23, official Government of India publication. Source PDF downloaded and preserved. Figures match published values. This is AGGREGATE state-level data only — not per-project.
